emergency_funds_shape.name: emergency_funds_shape
emergency_funds_shape.value:
"emergency_funds"."dependents" between 0 and 3 and ("emergency_funds"."spending_sen" is null or "emergency_funds"."spending_sen" >= 0)
  and ("emergency_funds"."own_target_sen" is null or "emergency_funds"."own_target_sen" >= 0) and "emergency_funds"."monthly_sen" >= 0 and ("emergency_funds"."target" <> 'own' or "emergency_funds"."own_target_sen" is not null)

goals_shape.name: goals_shape
goals_shape.value: "goals"."target_sen" > 0 and length("goals"."name") between 1 and 60 and ("goals"."by_month" is null or "goals"."by_month" ~ '^[0-9]{4}-(0[1-9]|1[0-2])$')

money_accounts_terms.name: money_accounts_terms
money_accounts_terms.value:
("money_accounts"."interest_bp" is null or "money_accounts"."interest_bp" between 0 and 100000)
    and ("money_accounts"."min_fixed_sen" is null or "money_accounts"."min_fixed_sen" >= 0) and ("money_accounts"."min_pct_bp" is null or "money_accounts"."min_pct_bp" between 0 and 10000)
    and ("money_accounts"."min_floor_sen" is null or "money_accounts"."min_floor_sen" >= 0) and ("money_accounts"."due_day" is null or "money_accounts"."due_day" between 1 and 31)
    and ("money_accounts"."statement_day" is null or "money_accounts"."statement_day" between 1 and 31)

things_shape.name: things_shape
things_shape.value:
"things"."cost_sen" >= 0 and "things"."yearly_bp" between -10000 and 10000 and "things"."share_bp" between 1 and 10000
  and ("things"."value_sen" is null or "things"."value_sen" >= 0) and (("things"."value_sen" is null) = ("things"."value_on" is null))

transactions_shape.name: transactions_shape
transactions_shape.value:
("transactions"."kind" = 'transfer' and "transactions"."to_account_id" is not null and "transactions"."to_account_id" <> "transactions"."account_id" and "transactions"."category_id" is null)
    or ("transactions"."kind" <> 'transfer' and "transactions"."to_account_id" is null and "transactions"."category_id" is not null)
